yaml.title: The Cynic's Guide to Church
yaml.subtitle: An 8-Session Class for People with Complicated Church Relationships

markdown.markdown:
::: {.session-banner}
::: {.session-number}
Welcome
:::
::: {.session-title}
We all bring our things to the table
:::
::: {.session-subtitle}
People have been hurt by churches. People have also been changed by churches. What do we do with the tension between those things?
:::
:::


This is a class for people who have **complicated, honest, unresolved feelings about the church**.

Not a debate. Not a recovery program. Not Sunday school. Not a space where you'll be told to forgive faster, doubt less, or look on the bright side.

It's a space where you can name what you've experienced...the good and the bad...examine it honestly, and figure out what to do with it.

Over eight sessions, we'll hold two things at the same time without letting either one cancel out the other:

- **The church has genuinely harmed people.**
- **The church has genuinely changed lives for good.**

Both are true. The goal is to wrestle with that tension in an honest way.

---

## Who this is for

This class is for:

- **Current attenders** who are struggling with aspects of their church experience
- **People who have stepped back or left** and aren't sure what to do next
- **Longtime churchgoers** who feel disillusioned but can't fully articulate why
- **Skeptics and returnees** who are somewhere in between
- **Church lovers** who are consistently lifted up by their church experience

You don't have to have it figured out.

---

## How to use this site

This site contains **everything for the class** — session guides, participant materials, discussion questions, and reflection exercises.

Each session page may include:

- A **podcast episode** you can download and listen to before or after the session
- **Background** and resources
- **Discussion questions** and activities


::: {.callout-note}
**Podcast episodes** are available as MP3 to play or download on each session page. You can listen before the class to orient yourself, or after to process what came up. They will use AI to generate from materials and notes on specific topics.
:::

---

## The high-level flow of the class

| # | Title | Core question |
|---|-------|---------------|
| 1 | **Purpose, Frameworks, Language** | Where does the church fit, language and frameworks of purpose, methods etc.? |
| 2 | **What are we experiencing?** | What lenses am I looking through and what do they show and hide? Authority, Abuse, Harm, Goodness, Beauty, Life |
| 3 | **What could be?** | What is realiste, What is possible? |

---

## Before you begin

Read the [Ground Rules](ground-rules.qmd) before your first session. They're not a list of restrictions...they're the conditions that make honest conversation possible.


---

*This class was built for a specific community, but the questions belong to anyone who has ever loved the church, been hurt by it, or both.*
